title: The totals-row Margin % is recomputed from the totals (total Margin ÷ total Total Sell), not the average of the row percentages
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The filtered set contains parts with clearly different Margin % values (so a recomputed figure differs from a simple average).
3. The Margin and Total Sell columns are turned on.
custom_steps:
1. Read the totals row's Margin, Total Sell, and Margin %.
2. Compute total Margin ÷ total Total Sell × 100 and compare to the shown Margin %.
3. Also compute the plain average of the row Margin % values and confirm the shown figure is NOT that.
custom_expected:
1. The totals-row Margin % equals total Margin ÷ total Total Sell × 100 (to one decimal place with a percent sign).
2. It is NOT the average of the row percentages.
3. It shows "—" when the total Total Sell is zero or negative.
